law: G1 (owner 2026-11-13): no blocking check without a producer. Every check id used in src/ has an entry naming the Kit command that produces the required state, whether that command runs before the check on the standard path, how an existing workspace migrates, and whether the resolving command may be repeated under consent already given.

fields.id: Check id; appears in the source as KIT-CHK-<NAME> at the blocking site.
fields.scope: kit: enforced by the Kit; workspace:<name>: a workspace rule the Kit's standard path must satisfy.
fields.producer_command: agentic-kit subcommand words that produce the required state.
fields.producer_runs_before_check: True when the standard path runs the producer before the check.
fields.exception: Required when producer_runs_before_check is false: why, and which correction closes it.
fields.migration: How an existing, previously green workspace reaches the required state.
fields.autonomous_retry: True when the resolving command may be rerun without new consent (transient obstacles only).
fields.incidents: Incidents from the 1.3.0 / 0.4.1 workflow-friction analysis that this entry answers.

release_path_law: G2 (owner 2026-11-13): a blocking check of the release path that depends only on repository content runs at the PR. work finish runs transfer standard-error-scan without --before-release (the release runs it with the flag) and the Kit CI pin guard (KIT-CHK-RELEASE-CONTENT-AT-PR). Every step of release ready, release prepare and the --before-release part of the scan is listed under release_path with its stage; tests/test_g2_release_checks_at_pr.py derives the steps from the source.

release_path_stages.pr: work finish runs this step (same name) before the commit.
release_path_stages.work-start: work start runs this step on main before any change.
release_path_stages.release-only: Needs release inputs (target version, date, previous tag, GitHub metadata, post-merge main); reason says why, check_id names the directory entry whose producer makes the content part pass at the PR.
release_path_stages.release-input: Validates the arguments of the release command, not repository content.
release_path_stages.advisory: Never blocks the release (accepted return codes 0 and 2, or warnings only).
release_path_stages.action: Produces state (sync, refresh, write); checks no repository content.

entries.check: release_changelog.curated_summary_lines: a curated release needs summary lines or Unreleased entries.
entries.exception: Workspaces: kit update writes the adoption line (K4) and work finish checks Unreleased at the PR (G2). The Kit's own release still uses the special make-new-kit-release path without summary lines (V1); closed by K8.
entries.migration: None: kit update writes the line from the next adoption on.

entries.check: release_changelog.curated_summary_lines: every Unreleased entry must be part of the curated summary.
entries.migration: None: without explicit summary lines the Unreleased entries are the summary.

entries.check: release_notes._validate_release_notes: no product PR may be Unclassified in the release.
entries.migration: PRs merged before K2 keep their label route; every new work finish sets a category (K2).

entries.check: checks.check_changelog_quality_text: a combined release section names at least three substance categories; curated sections are exempt (owner E2 b).
entries.migration: Curated workspaces: the count no longer applies; placeholder and substance checks stay.

entries.check: work finish (G2): Unreleased problems the release gate would reject, reported at the PR.
entries.migration: A workspace with a wrapped or placeholder Unreleased bullet is told at its next work finish and fixes the line.

entries.check: work finish: uncommitted tracked changes need --path; without --path existing commits are published (K1).
entries.migration: None: work finish without --path now publishes existing commits.

entries.check: transfer commit: .git/index.lock held by another git process after five attempts 2 s apart (K5).

tests/test_site_fallback_staleness.py (PR CI): docs/site, docs/index.html and docs/.nojekyll equal a fresh docs-pages fallback build; the build pins source hashes (cli_commands/human_workflows.py) and the command manifest.
entries.migration: None: the next work finish rebuilds and commits the projection before the PR; release prepare keeps its own refresh.

entries.check: agp-cockpit tests/test_hygiene.py: with Unreleased entries the build id must be release-<version>-r<N>.
entries.exception: kit update now writes the Unreleased line (K4); raising the build revision in the same PR is the Cockpit's C2.
entries.migration: Cockpit C2 after the next Kit release.

entries.check: work finish (G2): the repository-content part of the release scan (transfer standard-error-scan without --before-release) and the Kit CI pin guard of release prepare, before the commit; on the branches of a release run whose A2 passed the step is a no-op.
entries.migration: None: the PR scan is the release scan without its release-only steps, so a workspace that passed release ready passes it; one whose release ready would fail learns it at its next work finish instead of in A2.

entries.check: transfer standard-error-scan --before-release: the LLM context carriers are fresh, or stale only in the clean post-merge state on main.
entries.migration: None: unchanged; release ready runs the refresh before the scan in external workspaces, the Kit accepts clean post-merge carrier staleness.

entries.check: release ready: no document is due for review at the target release (REVIEW_DUE_RELEASE); warn-only in external workspaces unless hygiene.doc_lifecycle is strict.
entries.exception: Review due at a release depends on the target version and the date, so the PR cannot decide it (G2 release-only). release ready names docs lifecycle sweep as the resolving step. No correction planned: when a document is reviewed stays an owner decision at release time.

release_path.reason: Brings main up to date before the checks.
Regenerates the LLM context carriers in external workspaces (producer of KIT-CHK-FRESH-CONTEXT-POST-MERGE).
work finish runs the same scan without --before-release; the release-only additions are listed under standard-error-scan --before-release.
Needs the previous release tag and the GitHub metadata of every merged PR; its content rule (no Unclassified PR) is set at the PR by work finish (K2).
Needs the target version and the release date; the Unreleased rules it applies are checked at the PR by work finish.
Review due at a release depends on the target version and the date.
Accepts return codes 0 and 2; reports the release state.
Workflow pins against the installed Kit; work finish runs the same guard.
Needs the previous release tag and GitHub PR metadata; the category is set at the PR (K2).
Writes or previews the release section for the target version and date; the Unreleased rules are checked at the PR.
--write only: regenerates command entrypoints.
--write only: regenerates the task-selection review projection.
--write only: refreshes the DPA readiness acknowledgement.
--write only: regenerates the successor handoff package.
--write only: regenerates the docs-pages projection.
--write only: writes the release evidence report.
work start runs it on main before the branch exists.
--version is required with --before-release.
A previous release tag must be given or derivable.
Accepts return codes 0 and 2.
Needs the previous release tag and GitHub PR metadata; the category is set at the PR (K2).
Needs the target version and the release date; the Unreleased rules are checked at the PR.
Blocks only before a release, on main after the merge; on a feature branch the carriers are stale until the handoff refresh of work finish, so the PR scan runs it without blocking.
